name: 46350 · Laporte, IN
findings: ZIP 46350 (Laporte) has 151 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46350 (Laporte) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46350 (Laporte) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
